professionalSummary.text: Embedded software engineer with experience developing C for microcontroller-based appliance control boards at Ridgeway Appliances from January 2020 to February 2024.
professionalSummary.witness: Embedded software engineer at Ridgeway Appliances from January 2020 to February 2024, in the laundry-controls firmware team of seven, working on washing-machine and dryer control boards.

experienceHighlights.text: Wrote motor-control state machine and door-lock driver in C for 2023 washing-machine control board, following firmware architecture set by platform lead.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the motor-control state machine and the door-lock driver in C for the 2023 washing-machine control board, following the firmware architecture set by the platform lead.

experienceHighlights.text: Added unit tests with Unity and Ceedling and ran hardware-in-the-loop regression suite on every firmware candidate, recording failures in defect tracker.
experienceHighlights.witness: Added unit tests with Unity and Ceedling and ran the hardware-in-the-loop regression suite on every firmware candidate, recording failures in the defect tracker.

experienceHighlights.text: Supported hardware engineers during board bring-up by writing test firmware to exercise sensors and motor driver on first prototype boards.
experienceHighlights.witness: Supported the hardware engineers during board bring-up, writing test firmware to exercise the sensors and the motor driver on the first prototype boards.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Door-lock driver module with unit tests and IEC 60730 class B self-test checklist completed and reviewed by platform lead.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the door-lock driver module with its unit tests and the IEC 60730 class B self-test checklist that the candidate completed and the platform lead reviewed.

skills.text: C programming for microcontroller-based appliance control boards.
skills.witness: Wrote the motor-control state machine and the door-lock driver in C for the 2023 washing-machine control board, following the firmware architecture set by the platform lead.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's work on C development, unit tests, hardware-in-the-loop testing, board bring-up support, and IEC 60730 compliance. They do not establish leadership of a product platform, ownership of architecture, or release decisions.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required due to unverified leadership claims and missing evidence for platform ownership.
